title: Reuse exact same-plane TypedAxis in strict relation projection
masterplan_authority: Revision 11 / Version 2.2.0 / Gate 1 — Renovation and owner-directed Genesis
finding: The strict Forest/Fourfold Boolean relation adapter constructed two separately validated TypedAxis objects for same-plane relations even though source and target are the exact same Fourfold plane with the exact same canonical node_ids. TypedAxis already preserves a canonical tuple without copying, so the second axis object was redundant representation and validation work.
primary_claim: Same-plane Boolean relation projection now constructs one TypedAxis and reuses that exact immutable object as both row_axis and column_axis. Cross-plane projection still constructs a distinct target axis. The change does not alter relation membership, Forest/Fourfold authority, Boolean scalar semantics, completeness refusal, hyperedge refusal, or promotion authority.
gardener_decision: Delete duplicate same-plane axis construction rather than add a cache or index. Reuse the exact existing TypedAxis object when source_plane equals target_plane, while retaining a distinct target axis for cross-plane relations. Pin object identity in the focused relation-projection tests so future refactors do not silently restore the redundant representation.
